note: Lien waiver forms set by state law, shown on the waiver page and on a conditional waiver item. Duracash points to the form; it never writes one. Add a state only from the statute's own text, with its citation as plain text.

GA.name: Georgia

forms.conditional_progress: Interim Waiver and Release Upon Payment
forms.unconditional_progress: Interim Waiver and Release Upon Payment
forms.conditional_final: Waiver and Release of Lien and Payment Bond Rights Upon Final Payment
forms.unconditional_final: Waiver and Release of Lien and Payment Bond Rights Upon Final Payment

notes: Georgia sets two forms, one for progress payments and one for the final payment. Use the form as the law words it.
By law the waiver takes effect only once the payment it names is received, so the same form serves before and after payment.
Not paid after signing? File an affidavit of nonpayment within 90 days of the waiver's date, or the waiver stands as if you were paid.
